Concentrated triage batch: `finding` → `pm:queue` + `domain:ui`, Task, S — `ObjectMap` pays `JSON.stringify(rawDataConfig)` on every render (plus a bare `getDataConfig` call in the render body) to buy an identity `useMemo(() => getDataConfig(schema), [schema])` gives for free. Apply the memo shape, verify the fetch-effect identity contract with the existing tests; if `schema` identity is itself unstable at some call site (the reason stringify was reached for), measure and report that instead of keeping the stringify.

## Claimed + dispatched — `domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat

PM session `session_01CSoz9uGhaaSgiq3hshtN7L`, branch `claude/issue-6018-objectmap-dataconfig-memo`.
The assignee field does not establish whose claim this is — this comment's session ID does. No earlier claim comment exists.

### 裁决 (binding)

`ObjectMap` pays `JSON.stringify(rawDataConfig)` on every render (plus a bare `getDataConfig` call in the render body) to buy an identity that `useMemo(() => getDataConfig(schema), [schema])` gives for free. **Apply the memo shape**, and **verify the fetch-effect identity contract against the existing tests.**

### ⛔ Premise fork — the important half

**If `schema` identity is itself unstable at some call site** — which is the reason someone reached for `stringify` in the first place — ⛔ **measure and report that instead of keeping the stringify.** Do not "fix" it by leaving the stringify in place, and do not silently swap one identity hack for another. An unstable `schema` identity is a different and larger card.

So: **before** applying the memo, find out whether any caller passes a fresh `schema` object per render. If one does, that is a stop-and-report.

### Traps

⚠️ **A performance card's pin is the identity contract, not the timing.** ⛔ Do not assert on render counts as a proxy for speed. The distinguishing assertion is that **the fetch effect does NOT re-fire when the component re-renders with an unchanged `schema`**, and **DOES** re-fire when `schema` changes — proven red before the fix on at least one of those directions.

⚠️ **`useMemo` is not a semantic guarantee** — React may discard the cache. If any behaviour *depends* on the memo holding rather than merely being faster, say so; the correct tool there is a ref or a stable key, not `useMemo`.

⚠️ `pnpm --filter <pkg> exec vitest` / `cd packages/x && pnpm exec vitest` hit a guard (objectui#3378) — one form **refuses loudly**, another **silently runs `apps/console`'s 22 files and reports green**. **Always run vitest from the repo root**; sanity-check the file/test count.

⚠️ `tsc` resolves workspace deps through **`dist`** while `vitest` aliases to **`src/`** — a type-check red can be unbuilt siblings, a real error, or both. Build the closure, then re-read.

### Standing rules

Predict direction before running; prove mutations on disk by grepping injected AND separately removed text; print the landing site; assert anchor uniqueness; restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM` with a **cwd-independent** command and confirm `git diff HEAD --stat` empty. Derive gates by enumerating **each CI job's own step list**. Changeset: let `check-changeset-presence` decide and quote its verdict line; ⛔ never `major`.

### Collision bounds

`packages/plugin-map` is yours alone. ⛔ #5977 (`ObjectMap.listViewMapConfigReach.test.tsx` stale narration) is open in the same area and is **not yours** — do not fold it in; report any same-file overlap. Eight sibling agents are live elsewhere — ⛔ do not edit `packages/plugin-form/**`, `packages/components/**`, `packages/plugin-list/**`, `packages/plugin-detail/**`, `packages/types/**`, `packages/core/**`, `packages/plugin-kanban/**`, `packages/app-shell/src/utils/**`, `examples/schema-catalog/**`, `apps/site/**`.

⛔ Leave the PR **draft** — the PM lands it.

That red is a correctness gain, not a timing proxy: `JSON.stringify` throws on unserializable input and `getDataConfig`'s passthrough branch returns the author's own `schema.data` VERBATIM (inline rows included), so a back-referencing record graph from an `$expand`-ed lookup crashed the whole map subtree from the render body. (2) `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-map/src/ --maxWorkers=2` → 'Test Files 16 passed (16) | Tests 92 passed (92)' — count sanity-checked as plugin-map scope, not apps/console's 22 files. All exit codes captured before any pipe. Downstream consumers (PREFIX form `pnpm --filter '...@object-ui/plugin-map'`): @object-ui/console, @object-ui/site, examples/schema-catalog — all apps/examples; no exported surface moved, the change is a private render-body memo.",
  "open_questions": [
    {
      "question": "`useMemo` is not a semantic guarantee, and this memo is load-bearing rather than merely faster: React may discard the cache, at which point the fetch effect sees a fresh `dataConfig` and re-fires — and `setData` re-renders, which is exactly what made the original comment say 'prevent infinite loops'. This PR does not change that exposure (old and new form are both a `useMemo`, the new one strictly cheaper and no less safe), but it does not fix it either. Should it be fixed, and as its own card?",
      "options": [
        "A — leave as is: both forms carry the identical exposure, React discarding a memo is rare, and no reported defect traces to it. Zero cost, keeps this card narrow.",
        "B — file a follow-up to key the fetch effect on the PRIMITIVES it actually reads (`dataConfig.provider`, `dataConfig.object`) rather than on an object identity at all, so no cache has to hold for correctness. The `useMemo` then becomes a pure optimisation, which is the only thing it is contractually allowed to be.",
        "C — swap the memo for a `useRef` / stable-key form that React cannot discard. Guarantees the identity, but keeps correctness resting on identity plumbing."
      ],
      "recommendation": "B, as a separate card. It is the only option that removes the dependency on the cache rather than reinforcing it, and it is contract-first: the effect declares the values it genuinely reads instead of a proxy object whose identity it must police. C is the identity hack the ruling explicitly forbade swapping in. A is acceptable in the interim and is what this PR ships, since the exposure is unchanged by it."
    }
  ],
  "out_of_scope_findings": [
    "NOT FILED — the GitHub issue search/list API is rate-limited for this identity right now ('API rate limit already exceeded for user ID 6219465'), and the standing rule is to search before filing, so I did not file blind. Handing it to the PM to file, fully specified: `SchemaRenderer` hands a render-fresh `schema` object to any node declaring `responsiveStyles`, defeating every downstream `[schema]` memo. `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:1076` — `const schemaForComponent = scopeClass ? { ...evaluatedSchema, className: mergedClassName } : evaluatedSchema;` — is not memoized, so for a node with ADR-0065 scoped styles it allocates a new object on every SchemaRenderer render even when the `evaluatedSchema` memo held. MEASURED with a throwaway probe component registered through the real SchemaRenderer path (probe deleted, not committed): plain node → stable=true; node with `responsiveStyles: { large: {...} }` → stable=false. Note `hasResponsiveStyles` requires a `large`/`medium`/`small`/`xsmall` key, so a `{ base: … }` shape does NOT trigger it. Blast radius is every renderer memoizing on `[schema]`, which now includes ObjectMap's `dataConfig` and `mapConfig` plus the whole marker cascade downstream (`markers` → `filteredMarkers` → `clusteredData`/`markerBounds` → `initialViewState`). Bounded, not a loop: fresh per PARENT render only, and ObjectMap's own setState does not re-render SchemaRenderer. Likely fix is memoizing `schemaForComponent` on `[evaluatedSchema, mergedClassName]`. Belongs to `packages/react` — outside this card's collision bounds, and a larger card as the dispatch anticipated. Suggested labels: `finding`, `domain:ui`."
  ]
}
